description: Agent runtime and model-condition registry for token-optimization evaluations. Evaluation profiles describe token-saving/tool surfaces; model conditions describe the evaluated agent runtime, provider, and model so future Claude/Anthropic runs do not get mixed with current Codex/OpenAI runs.

agent_runtimes.notes: Current production evaluation runtime. It can vary OpenAI/Codex model settings when the run record binds agent.model, but it must not be used for Claude Code or Anthropic-native runs.

agent_runtimes.transcript_artifact: OpenCode raw JSON events nested in workflow JSONL evidence
agent_runtimes.notes: Official OpenCode runtime reached through the workflow controller's narrow compatibility adapter. The adapter preserves raw OpenCode events and normalizes only continuity and accounting fields.

Provider-free normal Claude Code runtime wiring is configured for the no-treatment control with exact project AGENTS.md-to-CLAUDE.md instruction materialization. The forward Claude Opus 5/medium condition uses an owner-provided Claude.ai/Anthropic account materialized into the lane-private CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; credentials never enter repository artifacts. Provider-backed reproduction remains blocked until the owner supplies the account and authorizes the bounded matrix.

model_conditions.usage_accounting: provider-reported Codex JSONL usage extracted by scripts/extract_codex_usage.py

runtime_pin.policy: Lanes run this pinned build, never the live install. The runner verifies this hash before every spending launch and refuses to run when it does not match, so an auto-update cannot change the measurement apparatus mid-study.

model_conditions.usage_accounting: provider-reported OpenCode step_finish usage extracted by scripts/extract_opencode_usage.py

model_conditions.authentication: owner-provided Claude.ai/Anthropic account through TOKEN_EVAL_CLAUDE_ACCOUNT_HOME; direct-account transport only
model_conditions.usage_accounting: provider-reported Claude Code stream-json result/assistant usage extracted by scripts/extract_claude_code_usage.py
model_conditions.runtime_version_policy: Captured per run into the session record's agent.version and compared between arms. This CLI auto-updates, so no single build can be asserted here truthfully: the field that used to say 2.1.220 was never the build any retained run used. Comparability is enforced where it can be violated -- two arms of one comparison must share a build, checked by validate_repository.runtime_version_divergence.

runtime_pin.policy: Lanes run this pinned build, never the live install. The runner verifies this hash before every spending launch and refuses to run when it does not match, so an auto-update cannot change the measurement apparatus mid-study.
